_header.description: E2 (CR-19): validation-selected truncation depth and dynamic-exit threshold, evaluated once on test. S1 goodness-sum readout, no TTA, EMA weights of stage1_best.

rules.T_iso_val: smallest depth d with acc_val(d) >= acc_val(L); applied once to test
rules.T_argmax_val: argmax_d acc_val(d), ties -> smallest d; applied once to test
rules.D_dynamic_exit: exit after block d<L when top1-top2 of running score > tau; tau grid = +-inf and 101 quantile levels of pooled val margins (depths 1..L-1); tau* = fewest val mean blocks with acc_val(tau) >= acc_val(L); applied once to test

_header.delta_definition: delta_test_pp = 100*(test acc at the selected operating point - test acc at full depth L), same checkpoint, same 10k test images

c10.convention: FLOPs = 2*MACs (torch FlopCounterMode); matmul/conv/SDPA counted, elementwise excluded

c100.convention: FLOPs = 2*MACs (torch FlopCounterMode); matmul/conv/SDPA counted, elementwise excluded

_header.sd: sample SD (ddof=1) across runs of a family
caveats: val and test are both single splits: 5k val -> 1 example = 0.02 pp; 10k test -> 0.01 pp
C10 arms: 9 different training configurations at seed 42 (one checkpoint each), SAM off
C100 trio: 3 variants x 3 seeds, L4/D256, single expert

claim_87_40.paper_text: adaptive tau=3, kappa=0 achieves 87.40% using only Block 0, exceeding its full 4-block accuracy of 87.06%; the constant-gamma baseline peaks at 87.48% at d=2 (appendix L 'Adaptive gating enables early exit'; fig:depth_truncation caption)
claim_87_40.protocol_found: VALIDATION split (5k, the run's own val_idx), flip-TTA, EMA weights, at the best-val epoch = epoch_metrics eval_top1_d<d>; i.e. the numbers are validation accuracies presented as if they were test accuracies, and d is 1-indexed (Block 0 = d=1)
